decisions.reason: Removing header navigation does not remove the shared header itself or change the requirement to use common headers and footers across webpages.
The footer impact is already fully represented by the message-44 MODIFY placing site-navigation links in the footer instead of the header.
Header-navigation removal does not alter the landing page's theme, typography, colors, hero treatment, or other visual-system attributes.
The How It Works section remains valid and unchanged despite removal of navigation links to landing-page sections.
Removing header navigation does not change whether previously supplied follow-on copy belongs on the landing page.
The landing page must still support responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts without header navigation.
The sign-up button remains an independent landing-page call to action and is not removed or changed by eliminating header navigation.
The source concerns website header navigation, not the separate console shell header or side-navigation panel.
Reusable responsive-design guidance remains applicable to website pages after header navigation is removed.
The navigation decision does not change the selected plain-HTML and Tailwind implementation stack or the decision not to use Astro.
Actia branding for the AWS Cognito sign-in page is independent of landing-page header navigation.
The provisioning wizard's visual specifications and unresolved accent choice are unrelated to landing-page header navigation.
